## What landed

`runBillingPeriodTick`'s subscription query and the free-tier daily-allowance query both move to
the RH-3 `join lateral` home-workspace pick (`order by created_at, id limit 1`) — one row per
subscription/account. Pre-fix `join workspaces` produced a row per (subscription × workspace):
every arm re-ran — the stale `downgrade_warned_at` snapshot re-sent the 7-day warning + lapse
notice once per workspace (each to a different workspace's owner) and counters inflated. The
daily-grant idempotency key already deduped the credit; the fan-out was wasted `runTx` rounds.
